newsitem.title: DENMARK: Norway's Statkraft raises amount on 4.0% bond.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Statkraft raises amount on 4.0% bond.

text.p: Norway's Statkraft SF raised an existing 1.1 billion Danish crown, four percent, six year bond offer to 1.3 billion crowns, lead manager Den Danske Bank said in a statement distributed by Copenhagen Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
The bond, with AA1 Moody's and AA+ Standard & Poor's ratings, matures on December 5, 2002 and will be on sale from Tuesday, Den Danske Bank said.
Statkraft produces about one third of all Norway's electricity and the bond loan is to fund operations, it said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
